unresolved: Which product dimensions are correct? The inch and centimeter triplets in the official product specification are not equivalent.
Which variable-ND range applies to PL-NKZ-CNDT: the 2–8 stops in its product name and highlights, the 6-stop description, or the 1–10 stops in the specification table?
Does PL-NKZ-CNDT provide a separate lens-aperture control, as claimed in one highlight, or only the ND control and PL locking ring shown in its product images?
notes: Product mass is published as 9.7 oz in the official Product Dimensions row (not Shipping Dimensions). Converted using 1 oz = 28.349523125 g and rounded to the nearest gram; approximate marks the rounded conversion, not a manufacturer-stated tolerance.
